heading: Application for Technology Specialist Graduate Programme
salutation: Dear DHL Supply Chain Recruitment Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Technology Specialist Graduate Programme at DHL Supply Chain because it combines the analytical and technical work I already do with the supply chain and logistics technology I want to build. The opportunity to gain broad experience across IT Operations, Technology Solutions, Project Delivery, Data & Analytics and Operational Technologies while working towards APM and ITIL certifications is exactly the environment I need to grow. I am available to start in September 2027 and comfortable with the Milton Keynes based location and occasional travel to nationwide sites.

My background combines practical IT support and security work with formal analytical training. I am an MSc Information Security graduate from Royal Holloway, awarded with Merit, with CompTIA Security+ and ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity, preceded by a BCA in computer applications. That means I understand not only how to resolve technical problems but how to approach complex challenges in a structured way, which is central to a role that requires problem solving, analytical thinking and continuous improvement.

In my current IT support position I am the first point of contact for 15 colleagues across 15 to 20 devices, troubleshooting access and system problems, monitoring server health and maintaining network and website-access controls. I handle four to five access requests a day through on-premises Active Directory and investigate four to five suspicious emails a day, recording findings and alerting colleagues to recurring tactics. I also built a local tool that maps Windows error codes to their common causes and used it to trace intermittent server freezes to missing or corrupted DLLs. My technical skills include Python, PowerShell and SQL, which I use for task automation and data analysis.

Two things I want to be straightforward about. I have not worked in supply chain or logistics, so that domain knowledge is something I would expect to develop through DHL's graduate programme rather than claim as existing experience. What I do bring is a genuine analytical mindset and attention to detail. At Co-op, as Person in Charge, I conduct weekly risk assessments and daily compliance checks, maintain the assessment records, and coordinate seven or eight colleagues per shift while explaining requirements to people who have no particular interest in them.

What draws me to DHL Supply Chain specifically is the focus on keeping products moving and businesses growing through technology. The opportunity to contribute to that work through a structured graduate programme with real responsibility, funded certifications and exposure to senior IT leaders is exactly the kind of challenge I am looking for. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experience could contribute to your team.
